This producer reads retained results and prepares an observed-context source
document. It creates neither a new portfolio nor a native model execution.
"""

def _copy(value):
    return deepcopy(value)


def _title(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError("Supply a scientific report source title")
    return value.strip()


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Retained report members need canonical relative names")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or any(p in (".", "..") for p in path.parts)
            or path.as_posix() != value):
        raise ValueError("Report source members must remain inside their source")
    return path.as_posix()


def _identity_file(item):
    return {key: item[key] for key in ("path", "bytes", "sha256")}


def _same_file(actual, expected):
    return all(actual.get(key) == expected.get(key) for key in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _text(value):
    if value is None:
        return "Not available"
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "Yes" if value else "No"
    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return format(value, ".10g")
    return str(value)

def _label(value):
    """Name schema fields without changing arbitrary user text or identifiers."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return _text(value)
    return _LABELS.get(value, value.replace("_", " ").replace(".", " / ").capitalize())


def _choice(value):
    return _CHOICES.get(value, value) if isinstance(value, str) else value


def _area(value):
    """Display hectares to six decimals, keeping nonzero subprecision values visible."""
    if not isinstance(value, (int, float)) or isinstance(value, bool):
        return _text(value)
    if 0 < value < 0.000001:
        return "Less than 0.000001"
    if -0.000001 < value < 0:
        return "Between -0.000001 and 0"
    return format(value, ",.6f").rstrip("0").rstrip(".") if value else "0"


def _rule_value(name, value):
    if name.endswith("_area_ha"):
        return _area(value)
    return _choice(value) if name in {"basis", "area_basis", "kind"} else value


def _table(columns, rows):
    return {"kind": "table", "columns": list(columns),
            "rows": [[_text(cell) for cell in row] for row in rows]}


def _links(items):
    return {"kind": "links", "items": [
        {"title": title, "path": _relative(path)} for title, path in items
    ]}


def _source_entries(workspace, state):
    """Resolve every selected planning/criterion source to its actual original."""
    references = conservation_reporting.source_register(state)
    sources = {}
    for reference in references:
        collection = identifier(reference.get("source_collection_id"))
        source_id = reference.get("source_id")
        if not isinstance(source_id, str) or not source_id:
            raise ValueError("A retained planning source lacks its actual source ID")
        key = (collection, source_id)
        if key not in sources:
            unused, entry = workspace.source_file(collection, source_id)
            sources[key] = {"source_collection_id": collection, "source_id": source_id,
                            "entry": _copy(entry), "references": []}
        resolved = sources[key]
        if not _same_file(resolved["entry"]["body"], reference["body"]):
            raise ValueError("A selected original source body differs from the saved study")
        # source_file verifies the immutable collection ID and all original
        # companions. Older study snapshots bind that collection and body but do
        # not duplicate companion descriptors; retain the actual source edition.
        expected = reference.get("companions")
        if expected:
            actual = resolved["entry"].get("companions", [])
            def member_keys(values):
                return sorted((item.get("view_path", item.get("filename")),
                               item["bytes"], item["sha256"]) for item in values)
            if member_keys(actual) != member_keys(expected):
                raise ValueError("Original source companions differ from the saved study")
        resolved["references"].append(_copy(reference))
    return [sources[key] for key in sorted(sources)]


def _retained_rows(workspace, state, plan):
    portfolio = read_json(verify_file(workspace.root, plan["files"]["portfolio"]))
    if (portfolio.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-portfolio/v1"
            or portfolio.get("id") != plan["id"]
            or portfolio.get("study_id") != state["id"]
            or portfolio.get("selected_ids") != plan["selected_ids"]
            or portfolio.get("summary") != plan["summary"]):
        raise ValueError("The original portfolio artifact and saved plan differ")
    rows = portfolio.get("selected_candidates")
    if (not isinstance(rows, list) or [row.get("id") for row in rows] != plan["selected_ids"]
            or len(set(plan["selected_ids"])) != len(rows)):
        raise ValueError("The original selected candidate rows differ from the saved plan")
    return rows


def _retained_optimization(workspace, state, plan):
    """Reopen the original saved decision analysis without solving it again."""
    reference = plan["selection"].get("optimization")
    if reference is None:
        return None
    from . import conservation_optimization
    if (not isinstance(reference, dict)
            or reference.get("schema") != conservation_optimization.REFERENCE_SCHEMA
            or reference.get("study_id") != state["id"]):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original saved optimization reference")
    retained = conservation_optimization.get_analysis(
        workspace, state["id"], identifier(reference.get("analysis_id")))
    analysis = retained["analysis"]
    selected = analysis.get("selected_ids")
    if (retained["state"]["files"] != reference.get("files")
            or analysis.get("request") != reference.get("request")
            or analysis.get("engine") != reference.get("engine")
            or analysis.get("normalization") != reference.get("normalization")
            or analysis.get("optimization") != reference.get("solver_result")
            or analysis.get("input", {}).get("study_id") != state["id"]
            or not isinstance(selected, list)
            or selected != reference.get("selected_ids")
            or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
            or set(selected) != set(plan["selected_ids"])):
        raise ValueError("The original optimization and selected portfolio differ")
    return retained



def _joint_comparison_blocks(analysis, units):

    if joint is None:
        return []
    cells = {row["id"]: row for row in joint["cells"]}
    name = lambda key: cells[key]["case"] + " / " + cells[key]["preference"]
    blocks = [
        joint["interpretation"],
        _table(["Included native cases", "Included preferences", "Evaluated combinations", "New maintained-solver calls"],
               [[joint["case_count"], joint["preference_count"], joint["cell_count"], joint["new_solver_calls"]]]),
        _table(["Case / preference", "Normalized weights", "Eligible units", "Selected original units",
                "Original solver objective", "Solver status", "Original upper bound", "Best known feasible score"],
               [[name(cell["id"]), cell["weights"], cell["eligible_count"], units(cell["selected_ids"]),
                 cell["optimization"]["objective_score"], cell["optimization"].get("status"),
                 cell["optimization"].get("upper_bound"), cell["best_known_feasible_score"]]
                for cell in joint["cells"]]),
        joint["regret"],
        "The original selected portfolio remains selected. These are the distinct portfolios found "
        "in the declared cells, not an enumeration of every feasible or globally robust portfolio. "
        "A portfolio unsupported in any cell has no full-grid loss bound; eligible-only values are "
        "not substituted. Different weight choices define different dimensionless objectives.",
        _table(["Portfolio", "Original units", "Supported combinations", "Maximum loss lower bound",
                "Maximum loss upper bound"],
               [[portfolio["id"] + (" (original selection)" if portfolio["id"] == joint["selected_portfolio_id"] else ""),
                 units(portfolio["selected_ids"]), str(portfolio["eligible_cells"]) + " / " + str(portfolio["cell_count"]),
                 portfolio["maximum_regret_lower_bound"], portfolio["maximum_regret_upper_bound"]]
                for portfolio in joint["portfolios"]]),
    ]
    for portfolio in joint["portfolios"]:
        blocks += [
            portfolio["id"] + ": " + units(portfolio["selected_ids"]) + ". Found in: "
            + "; ".join(name(key) for key in portfolio["origin_cells"]),
            _table(["Case / preference", "Cross-evaluated score", "Loss lower bound", "Loss upper bound",
                    "Support and original exclusions"],
                   [[name(value["cell_id"]), value["objective_score"], value["regret_lower_bound"],
                     value["regret_upper_bound"],
                     "Complete" if value["eligible"] else "; ".join(
                         units([item["feature_id"]]) + ": " + "; ".join(item["reasons"])
                         for item in value["unavailable_units"])]
                    for value in portfolio["evaluations"]]),
        ]
    blocks += [
        joint["physical_scope"],
        "The three complete CSVs retain every cell, every cross-evaluated portfolio, and every "
        "candidate's rank, weighted contributions, selection or exclusion. Original physical "
        "quantities, units, native run/family definitions and source footprints remain in the "
        "unchanged analysis and original case sections.",
        _links([("Every joint cell and solver result", "optimization/joint-cells.csv"),
                ("Every portfolio across every cell", "optimization/joint-portfolios.csv"),
                ("Every candidate and original exclusion", "optimization/joint-candidates.csv")]),
    ]
    return blocks

def _optimization_section(retained):
    """Explain the retained decision in the original structured report format."""
    analysis = retained["analysis"]
    request = analysis["request"]
    objective = request["objective"]
    candidates = {row["feature_id"]: row for row in analysis["candidates"]}
    selected = [candidates[key] for key in analysis["selected_ids"]]
    criteria = {row["id"]: row for row in objective.get("criteria", [])}
    labels = {axis: criteria.get(axis, {}).get("label", axis.replace("_", " "))
              for axis in request["axes"]}

    def units(keys):
        return "; ".join((candidates[key].get("label") or key) + " [" + key + "]"
                         for key in keys) or "None"

    def rank_range(value):
        if not value or value.get("minimum_rank") is None:
            return "Not available"
        return str(value["minimum_rank"]) + " to " + str(value["maximum_rank"])

    def frequency(value, selected_key, total_key):
        if not value:
            return "Not compared"
        return str(value[selected_key]) + " / " + str(value[total_key])

    rows = [
        ["Original analysis ID", analysis["id"]],
        ["Objective kind", _choice(objective.get("kind"))],
        ["Objective basis", _choice(objective.get("basis"))],
        ["Objective scope", analysis["methods"].get("objective_scope")],
        ["Original candidate count", analysis["counts"].get("inventory")],
        ["Eligible candidate count", analysis["counts"].get("eligible")],
        ["Selected candidate count", analysis["counts"].get("selected")],
        ["Normalized objective score", analysis["selection"].get("objective_score")],
        ["Original solver module", analysis["engine"].get("module")],
        ["Original solver SHA-256", analysis["engine"].get("sha256")],
    ]
    for group, values in (("Constraint", request.get("constraints", {})),
                          ("Solver result", analysis.get("optimization", {}))):
        rows.extend([group + ": " + _label(name), _rule_value(name, value)] for name, value in values.items()
                    if not isinstance(value, (dict, list)))
    blocks = [
        "This portfolio was selected by its retained optimization analysis and then stored "
        "through the original manual-ID plan interface. The storage mode does not replace "
        "its original objective, solver or constraints.",
        _table(["Decision record", "Retained value"], rows),
        _text(analysis["methods"].get("optimality_scope")),
        _text(analysis["methods"].get("selected_result")),
    ]
    meanings = {
        "source-context": "Original geographic overlap or designation context; not pollutant removal",
        "current-export": "Baseline modeled export; not an intervention benefit",
        "restoration": "Baseline minus the retained alternative on common valid native support",
        "avoided-conversion": "Retained disturbance alternative minus baseline on common valid native support",
        "matched-restoration": "Own-family baseline minus treatment on one common footprint across all declared families",
        "matched-disturbance": "Own-family treatment minus baseline on one common footprint across all declared families",
        "published-method": "Original method/category priority points with their retained prerequisites",
        "source-attribute": "Unchanged numeric source attribute with analyst-declared unit/reference; no inferred connectivity or unit conversion",
    }
    definitions, source_rows, weighted = [], [], []
    for axis in request["axes"]:
        criterion = criteria.get(axis, {})
        kind = criterion.get("kind", objective["kind"])
        first = next((row for row in candidates.values() if axis in row["objective_units"]), None)
        unit = first["objective_units"][axis] if first else criterion.get("unit")
        basis = criterion.get("basis", objective.get("basis", "total"))
        direction = criterion.get("direction", "maximize")
        definitions.append([labels[axis] + " [" + axis + "]",
                            criterion.get("field") or criterion.get("axis") or axis,
                            unit, basis, direction])
        description = meanings.get(kind, kind)
        references = []
        if criterion.get("reference"):
            references.append(criterion["reference"])
        source = criterion.get("source") or {}
        if source.get("source_id"):
            references.append("Original source " + source["source_id"])
        if source.get("source_collection_id"):
            references.append("Collection " + source["source_collection_id"])
        baseline = source.get("baseline_run_id")
        if baseline:
            references.append("Baseline " + baseline)
        family_id = criterion.get("family_id", objective.get("family_id"))
        if family_id:
            references.append("Matched family " + family_id)
        alternative = criterion.get("scenario_run_id", objective.get("scenario_run_id")) or source.get("alternative_run_id")
        if alternative:
            references.append("Alternative " + alternative)
        method = criterion.get("published_method") or analysis["request"].get("published_method") or {}
        if method:
            references += [str(method[name]) for name in ("method_id", "category_id", "reference", "source_uri")
                           if method.get(name)]
        source_rows.append([labels[axis], description,
                            "; ".join(references) or "Original study/source bindings in the attached analysis"])
        weighted.append([labels[axis], request["weights"].get(axis, 0),
                         analysis["normalization"]["scales"].get(axis),
                         "Negated normalized value" if direction == "minimize" else "Signed normalized value"])
    blocks += [
        "The following criteria are the scientist's explicit decision choices. Each keeps its "
        "own units and original source meaning; only their normalized weighted contributions "
        "are combined into a dimensionless score.",
        _table(["Criterion / ID", "Original axis or field", "Unit", "Quantity basis", "Direction"], definitions),
        _table(["Criterion", "Source meaning", "Original reference"], source_rows),
        _table(["Criterion", "Normalized weight", "Fixed absolute scale", "Score direction"], weighted),
        "A supported value is divided by its criterion's maximum absolute scale. Minimize negates "
        "that normalized value. Weights total one and weighted contributions sum to the score. "
        "A supported zero has zero contribution; unavailable positive-weight support excludes a "
        "candidate. Missing values are not credited as zeros.",
        ("Scales are fixed across the selected case and every distinct enabled native comparison "
         "case, then reused across all named preference profiles. Adding a case defines a new analysis."
         if analysis["normalization"].get("fixed_across_scenario_cases") else
         "Scales are fixed across the selected source-qualified candidate universe and reused for "
         "the preference comparisons."),
    ]
    preference = analysis["stability"]
    preference_compared = bool(preference["enabled"] and len(preference["profiles"]) > 1)
    preference_rows = []
    for profile in preference["profiles"]:
        weights = "; ".join(labels.get(key, key) + ": " + _text(value)
                            for key, value in profile["weights"].items() if value > 0)
        preference_rows.append([profile["name"], weights, profile["eligible_count"],
                                units(profile["selected_ids"]), profile["optimization"]["objective_score"]])
    blocks += [
        ("Preference comparison changes weights within the selected case; it does not vary the "
         "native inputs. The rows below retain each explicit profile's feasible selection."
         if preference_compared else
         "No distinct preference comparison is enabled. The following row retains the selected "
         "weights and their feasible selection."),
        _table(["Preference", "Positive normalized weights", "Eligible units", "Selected original units", "Objective score"],
               preference_rows),
        _text(preference.get("interpretation")),
    ]
    scenario = analysis.get("scenario_stability") or {}
    compared = bool(scenario.get("enabled") and len(scenario.get("cases", [])) > 1)
    if compared:
        case_rows = []
        for case in scenario["cases"]:
            mappings = [labels.get(key, key) + ": alternative " + value
                        for key, value in case.get("scenario_run_ids", {}).items()]
            mappings += [labels.get(key, key) + ": matched family " + value
                         for key, value in case.get("family_ids", {}).items()]
            mapping = "; ".join(mappings) or "No paired criterion"
            case_rows.append([case["name"], mapping, case["eligible_count"],
                              units(case["selected_ids"]), case["optimization"]["objective_score"]])
        blocks += [
            "Native-case comparisons use the explicitly mapped original alternatives or matched "
            "baseline/treatment families at the same selected weights and resource limits. A matched "
            "family keeps its own baseline; fixed-baseline criteria keep the original study baseline. "
            "Context and source attributes retain their original meaning.",
            _table(["Retained case", "Criterion / original alternative", "Eligible units", "Selected original units", "Objective score"],
                   case_rows),
            _text(scenario.get("interpretation")),
            "Fixed-baseline criteria retain their original pairwise support. Matched-family criteria "
            "use one shared footprint per pollutant across every declared family, with the same "
            "parameter profile inside each pair. The full family definitions and support areas below "
            "describe their scientific setting. These case comparisons are separate from named "
            "decision-weight preferences and do not assign a joint probability.",
        ]
    else:
        blocks.append("No distinct native-case comparison is enabled in this decision. The "
                      "selected case alone does not establish scenario robustness.")
    stability_rows, contribution_rows = [], []
    for row in selected:
        name = (row.get("label") or row["feature_id"]) + " [" + row["feature_id"] + "]"
        pref = row["preference_stability"] if preference_compared else None
        case = row.get("scenario_stability") if compared else None
        stability_rows.append([name, row["rank"], row["score"],
                               ("Selected " + frequency(pref, "selected_profiles", "profile_count")
                                + "; eligible " + frequency(pref, "eligible_profiles", "profile_count")
                                + "; rank " + rank_range(pref)) if pref else "Not compared",
                               ("Selected " + frequency(case, "selected_cases", "case_count")
                                + "; eligible " + frequency(case, "eligible_cases", "case_count")
                                + "; rank " + rank_range(case))
                               if case else "Not compared"])
        for axis in request["axes"]:
            support = row["axis_support"][axis]
            contribution = row.get("score_contributions", {}).get(axis)
            if "score_contributions" not in row and support["eligible_support"]:
                contribution = request["weights"][axis] * row["normalized_metrics"][axis]
            detail = str(support["availability"])
            if support.get("coverage_fraction") is not None:
                detail += "; coverage " + _text(support["coverage_fraction"])
            if support.get("valid_area_ha") is not None:
                detail += "; valid area " + _area(support["valid_area_ha"]) + " ha"
            if support.get("availability_reason"):
                detail += "; " + support["availability_reason"]
            if support.get("profile_changed"):
                detail += "; parameter profile changed"
            contribution_rows.append([name, labels[axis],
                                      _text(row["objective_values"][axis]) + " " + row["objective_units"][axis],
                                      contribution, detail])
    blocks += [
        "The following detail is limited to the land selected in this saved portfolio. All "
        "unselected candidates and case-specific values remain in the unchanged attached analysis.",
        _table(["Selected original unit", "Rank", "Score", "Preference selection / eligibility / rank",
                "Case selection / eligibility / rank"], stability_rows),
        _table(["Selected original unit", "Criterion", "Original value and unit",
                "Weighted score contribution", "Source support"], contribution_rows),
        "Selection frequencies describe only the included preferences and cases; they are not "
        "probabilities or calibrated confidence levels. Original quantities, points and hectares "
        "remain separate. Additive candidate scores and density sums are not basin totals, and "
        "overlapping source units can repeat support. The authoritative saved plan recomputes "
        "physical quantities on the selected reporting union.",
        "The full normalized candidate table, original source references, all declared preference "
        "profiles, native-case quantities and solver details are attached unchanged.",
        _links([
            ("Original complete optimization analysis", "optimization/analysis.json"),
            ("Original full optimization candidate table", "optimization/candidates.csv"),
            ("Original optimization report", "optimization/index.html"),
        ]),
    ]
    blocks += _joint_comparison_blocks(analysis, units)
    return ["Original saved optimization", blocks]

    sections = [["Matched native family definitions", [
        "Each treatment is compared with its own completed baseline under the same retained "
        "parameter profile and grid. The analyst's original scientific setting identifies the "

        _table(["Family", "Original baseline", "Original treatment", "Scientific setting", "Reference"],
               [[row["label"] + " [" + row["id"] + "]", row["baseline_run_id"],
                 row["alternative_run_id"], row["reason"], row.get("reference")]
                for row in families]),
    ]]]

def _write_bundle(directory, files, target):
    """Write the source manifest and every companion without extracting a packet."""
    pending = None
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=directory, prefix=".source-", suffix=".zip",
                                         delete=False) as temporary:
            pending = Path(temporary.name)
        with zipfile.ZipFile(pending, "w", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
                             compresslevel=5, allowZip64=True) as archive:
            for name, descriptor in sorted(files.items()):
                source = verify_file(directory, descriptor)
                info = zipfile.ZipInfo(_relative(name), date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
                info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
                with source.open("rb") as stream, archive.open(info, "w", force_zip64=True) as out:
                    for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                        out.write(block)
                verify_file(directory, descriptor)
        if target.exists():
            if target.stat().st_size != pending.stat().st_size or file_digest(target) != file_digest(pending):
                raise ValueError("Retained report-source bundle differs")
            pending.unlink()
        else:
            pending.replace(target)
        pending = None
    finally:
        if pending is not None:
            pending.unlink(missing_ok=True)


def _verify_source(workspace, value):
    choice = value["source"]
    unused, entry = workspace.source_file(choice["source_collection_id"], choice["source_id"])
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != observed_context.ROLE
            or not _same_file(entry["body"], value["files"]["recipe"])):
        raise ValueError("The original report recipe source differs from its receipt")
    actual = {item.get("view_path", item["filename"]): item
              for item in entry.get("companions", [])}
    expected = value["members"]
    if len(actual) != len(entry.get("companions", [])) or set(actual) != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Original report source companion membership differs")
    for name, item in expected.items():
        if not _same_file(actual[name], item):
            raise ValueError("Original report source companion differs: " + name)
    current = observed_context.bind(workspace, {"source_roles": {observed_context.ROLE: choice}})
    if current != value["observed_binding"]:
        raise ValueError("Original scientific-report source binding differs")
    return value

REPORT_EDITIONS = frozenset(("conservation-saved-plan-report/1",
                             "conservation-saved-plan-report/2",
                             "conservation-saved-plan-report/3",
                             "conservation-saved-plan-report/4",
                             "conservation-saved-plan-report/5",
                             "conservation-saved-plan-report/6"))


def _path(kind, key):
    return kind + "/" + identifier(key) + "/" + DOCUMENTS[kind]


def _relative(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str) or "\\" in value or "\0" in value:
        raise ValueError("Keep the original Conservation member path.")
    path = PurePosixPath(value)
    if (path.is_absolute() or not path.parts or ".." in path.parts
            or path.as_posix() != value or any(":" in part for part in path.parts)):
        raise ValueError("Keep the original relative Conservation member path.")
    return value


def _same(left, right):
    return isinstance(left, dict) and isinstance(right, dict) and all(
        name in left and left[name] == right.get(name) for name in ("bytes", "sha256"))


def _files(closure, files, prefix=None):
    for item in files.values():
        name = _relative(item["path"])
        if prefix is not None and not name.startswith(prefix + "/"):
            raise ValueError("A Conservation output leaves its original record directory.")
        closure.add_file(name, item)


def _read_file(closure, item):
    closure.add_file(_relative(item["path"]), item)
    return closure.read(item["path"])


def _record(closure, kind, key):
    return closure.read(_path(kind, key))


def _identity(kind, key, value):
    if value.get("id") != key:
        raise ValueError("The retained Conservation record has another identity.")
    if kind == "conservation":
        schema = "upstate.conservation-study/v1"
    elif kind == "conservation-plans":
        schema = "upstate.conservation-plan/v1"
    elif kind == "conservation-report-sources":
        schema = REPORT_SCHEMA
    else:
        schema = value.get("schema")
        if schema not in ("upstate.conservation-export/v1",
                          "upstate.conservation-decision-export/v1"):
            raise ValueError("Choose an original Conservation decision packet.")
    if value.get("schema") != schema:
        raise ValueError("The retained Conservation record has another schema.")
    if kind != "conservation-exports" or schema == "upstate.conservation-decision-export/v1":
        if digest(value.get("selection")) != key:
            raise ValueError("The retained Conservation selection changed.")


def _source_entry(closure, choice, expected=None):
    collection_id = identifier(choice["source_collection_id"])
    value = closure.read("sources/" + collection_id + ".json")
    if value.get("schema") != "upstate.sources/v1" or digest(value) != collection_id:
        raise ValueError("The original Conservation source collection changed.")
    rows = [entry for entry in value.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id") == choice["source_id"]]
    if len(rows) != 1:
        raise ValueError("The Conservation source no longer identifies one original entry.")
    entry = rows[0]
    if expected is not None and entry != expected:
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report source differs from its original source edition.")
    closure.need("sources", collection_id, "Original Conservation source edition")
    for item in [entry["body"], *entry.get("companions", [])]:
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
    return entry


def _entry_identity(entry):
    members = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("A Conservation source repeats an original companion.")
        members[name] = {field: item[field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")}
    return {**{name: entry.get(name) for name in
               ("id", "kind", "title", "uri", "vintage", "role", "metadata")},
            "body": {field: entry["body"][field] for field in ("bytes", "sha256")},
            "companions": members}


def _study(closure, key, value):
    from .conservation_reporting import source_register
    selection = value["selection"]
    if selection.get("version") != 1 or value.get("mode") != selection["spec"].get("mode"):
        raise ValueError("The original Conservation study mode or selection differs.")
    closure.tree("conservation/" + key)
    _files(closure, value.get("files", {}), "conservation/" + key)
    for row in source_register(value):
        original = _source_entry(closure, row)
        if not _same(original["body"], row["body"]):
            raise ValueError("A Conservation planning source differs from its saved body.")
        if row.get("companions") and row["companions"] != original.get("companions"):
            raise ValueError("A Conservation planning source differs from its saved companions.")
    bound = selection["bindings"]
    for run_id, native in bound.get("runs", {}).items():
        if native.get("id") != run_id:
            raise ValueError("The Conservation study names another bound native run.")
        closure.need("runs", run_id, "Original Conservation producing-stage native run")
        current = closure.read("runs/" + identifier(run_id) + "/run.json")
        if current.get("selection") != native.get("selection"):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation study's original native run selection differs.")
        for output in native.get("outputs", {}).values():
            for name in ("rate", "stream", "arguments"):
                if isinstance(output.get(name), dict):
                    closure._descriptors(output[name], "runs/" + run_id + "/")
    grid = bound.get("grid")
    if grid:
        closure.need("grids", grid["id"], "Original Conservation model grid")
        closure._descriptors(grid["reporting_area"], "grids/" + identifier(grid["id"]) + "/")
    # These are explicit bound source choices, including published criterion inputs.
    closure._source_refs(bound, "Original Conservation bound criteria and geography")


def _optimization_roles(analysis):
    roles = {"analysis": "analysis.json", "candidates": "candidates.csv", "report": "index.html"}
    if "joint_comparison" in analysis:
        joint = analysis["joint_comparison"]
        if not isinstance(joint, dict) or joint.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-joint-comparison/v1":
            raise ValueError("Keep the original joint Conservation comparison schema.")
        roles.update({name: name for name in (
            "joint-cells.csv", "joint-portfolios.csv", "joint-candidates.csv")})
    return roles


def _optimization_analysis(study, plan, analysis):
    """Check the producer's retained decision contract using original JSON only."""
    reference = plan["selection"].get("optimization")
    if (not isinstance(reference, dict)
            or reference.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-optimization-reference/v1"
            or reference.get("study_id") != study["id"]):
        raise ValueError("Retain the original saved Conservation optimization reference.")
    key = identifier(reference.get("analysis_id"))
    selected = analysis.get("selected_ids")
    if (analysis.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-optimization/v1"
            or analysis.get("id") != key
            or digest({name: item for name, item in analysis.items() if name != "id"}) != key
            or analysis.get("request") != reference.get("request")
            or analysis.get("engine") != reference.get("engine")
            or analysis.get("normalization") != reference.get("normalization")
            or analysis.get("optimization") != reference.get("solver_result")
            or analysis.get("input", {}).get("study_id") != study["id"]
            or not isinstance(selected, list)
            or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in selected)
            or selected != reference.get("selected_ids")
            or len(selected) != len(set(selected))
            or set(selected) != set(plan["selected_ids"])):
        raise ValueError("The original optimization and selected Conservation portfolio differ.")
    if not isinstance(reference.get("files"), dict) or set(reference["files"]) != set(_optimization_roles(analysis)):
        raise ValueError("Retain the exact original optimization and joint-comparison companions.")
    return {"id": key, "files": reference["files"]}


def _plan(closure, key, value):
    study_id = identifier(value["study_id"])
    closure.need("conservation", study_id, "Original Conservation portfolio candidate study")
    study = _record(closure, "conservation", study_id)
    _identity("conservation", study_id, study)
    selection = value["selection"]
    if (selection.get("study_id") != study_id
            or selection.get("candidates_sha256") != study["files"]["candidates"]["sha256"]
            or selection.get("geometries_sha256") != study["files"]["geometries"]["sha256"]):
        raise ValueError("The portfolio differs from its original candidate or geometry inventory.")
    closure.tree("conservation-plans/" + key)
    _files(closure, value.get("files", {}), "conservation-plans/" + key)
    if value.get("state") == "complete":
        portfolio = _read_file(closure, value["files"]["portfolio"])
        if (portfolio.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-portfolio/v1"
                or portfolio.get("id") != key or portfolio.get("study_id") != study_id
                or portfolio.get("selected_ids") != value.get("selected_ids")
                or portfolio.get("summary") != value.get("summary")):
            raise ValueError("The original portfolio artifact differs from its saved selection.")
    optimization = selection.get("optimization")
    if optimization:
        analysis_id = identifier(optimization["analysis_id"])
        prefix = "conservation/" + study_id + "/optimization/" + analysis_id
        state = closure.read(prefix + "/analysis-state.json")
        if (state.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-optimization-reference/v1"
                or state.get("id") != analysis_id or state.get("study_id") != study_id
                or state.get("files") != optimization.get("files")):
            raise ValueError("The portfolio lost its original optimization analysis.")
        _files(closure, state["files"], prefix)
        analysis = _read_file(closure, state["files"]["analysis"])
        _optimization_analysis(study, value, analysis)
        closure.tree(prefix)
    catalog = selection.get("catalog_selection")
    if catalog:
        selection_id = identifier(catalog["selection_id"])
        prefix = "conservation/" + study_id + "/catalog-selections/" + selection_id
        saved = closure.read(prefix + "/selection.json")
        if (saved.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-candidate-selection/v1"
                or saved.get("id") != selection_id or digest(saved.get("reference")) != selection_id
                or saved.get("study_id") != study_id or saved.get("index_id") != catalog.get("index_id")
                or saved.get("source_inventory") != study["files"]["candidates"]
                or saved.get("source_inventory") != catalog.get("source_inventory")
                or saved.get("reference") != catalog.get("reference")
                or saved["files"]["selected_ids"] != catalog.get("selected_ids_file")):
            raise ValueError("The portfolio lost its exact retained candidate selection.")
        _files(closure, saved["files"], prefix)
        selected = _read_file(closure, saved["files"]["selected_ids"])
        ids = selected.get("selected_ids")
        if (selected.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-selected-ids/v1"
                or selected.get("reference") != saved["reference"]
                or not isinstance(ids, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in ids)
                or ids != sorted(set(ids)) or len(ids) != saved["count"]
                or catalog.get("original_count") != saved["count"]):
            raise ValueError("The original candidate selection file differs.")
        resolved = sorted((set(ids) | set(catalog.get("include_ids", [])))
                          - set(catalog.get("exclude_ids", [])))
        if (resolved != selection.get("selected_ids")
                or catalog.get("resolved_count") != len(resolved)):
            raise ValueError("The portfolio differs from its original retained candidate edits.")
        closure.tree(prefix)


def _export(closure, key, value):
    study_id = identifier(value["study_id"])
    closure.need("conservation", study_id, "Original Conservation decision-packet study")
    plan_id = value.get("plan_id")
    if plan_id:
        closure.need("conservation-plans", plan_id, "Original Conservation decision-packet portfolio")
    subject = _record(closure, "conservation-plans" if plan_id else "conservation", plan_id or study_id)
    prefix = "conservation-exports/" + key
    closure.tree(prefix)
    _files(closure, {"archive": value}, prefix)
    if value["schema"] == "upstate.conservation-export/v1":
        identity = {"version": 1, "study_id": study_id, "plan_id": plan_id,
                    "files": subject["files"], "presentation": value["presentation"]}
        execution_name = prefix + "/native-execution.json"
        if (closure.root / execution_name).exists():
            execution = closure.read(execution_name)
            if (execution.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-native-execution/v1"
                    or execution.get("study_id") != study_id):
                raise ValueError("The packet native execution belongs to another study.")
            identity["native_execution"] = execution["runs"]
        if digest(identity) != key:
            raise ValueError("The decision packet differs from its original selected files.")
    else:
        selection = value["selection"]
        if selection.get("plan_id") != plan_id or selection.get("study_id") != study_id:
            raise ValueError("The optimization packet selects another original portfolio.")
        original = selection["original_packet"]
        path = PurePosixPath(_relative(original["path"]))
        if len(path.parts) != 3 or path.parts[0] != "conservation-exports":
            raise ValueError("The optimized decision packet needs its original Conservation packet.")
        closure.add_file(original["path"], original)
        closure.need("conservation-exports", path.parts[1], "Original packet beneath optimized Conservation export")
        reference = subject["selection"].get("optimization") or {}
        if (selection.get("analysis_id") != reference.get("analysis_id")
                or selection.get("analysis_files") != reference.get("files")):
            raise ValueError("The optimized packet lost its original saved analysis.")


def _receipt(closure, key, value):
    if value.get("state") != "complete" or value.get("edition") not in REPORT_EDITIONS:
        raise ValueError("Choose a completed original Conservation report-source capture.")
    selection = value["selection"]
    if (selection.get("project_id") != closure.workspace.project["id"]
            or selection.get("edition") != value["edition"]
            or any(selection.get(name) != value.get(name) for name in ("plan_id", "study_id", "title"))):
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report source belongs to another original selection.")
    closure.tree("conservation-report-sources/" + key)
    _files(closure, value["files"], "conservation-report-sources/" + key)
    _files(closure, value["members"], "conservation-report-sources/" + key)
    for kind, name in (("conservation", "study"), ("conservation-plans", "plan")):
        record_id = identifier(value[name + "_id"])
        if selection[name].get("path") != _path(kind, record_id):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report retained another original record path.")
        closure.add_file(selection[name]["path"], selection[name])
        closure.need(kind, record_id, "Original editable Conservation report study")
    packet = selection["packet"]
    closure.add_file(packet["path"], packet)
    closure.need("conservation-exports", packet["id"], "Original Conservation report decision packet")
    for original in selection["source_entries"]:
        _source_entry(closure, original, original["entry"])
    entry = _source_entry(closure, value["source"])
    if (entry.get("id") != "conservation-portfolio-" + key
            or not _same(entry["body"], value["files"]["recipe"])):
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report receipt differs from its imported source.")
    include_source(closure, value["source"]["source_collection_id"], entry)


def visit(closure, kind, key, value):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return False
    _identity(kind, key, value)
    {"conservation": _study, "conservation-plans": _plan,
     "conservation-exports": _export, "conservation-report-sources": _receipt}[kind](closure, key, value)
    return True

            "workspace_id": closure.workspace.project["id"], "plan_id": plan["id"], "study_id": study["id"],

    _files(closure, value.get("files", {}), "conservation-scenarios/" + key)
    for field, kind in (("scenario_id", "scenarios"), ("run_id", "runs"),
                        ("source_collection_id", "sources")):

        handoff = closure.read(handoff_path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
        link = closure.read((handoff_path.parent / "selection.json").relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
        if (handoff.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-experiment-handoff/v1"
                or handoff.get("id") != handoff_path.parent.name or digest(link) != handoff["id"]
                or handoff.get("conservation_scenario_id") != key
                or link.get("source_reference") != handoff.get("source_reference")
                or link.get("selection") != handoff.get("selection")):
            raise ValueError("The retained Conservation experiment handoff changed.")
        for field, kind in (("experiment_id", "experiments"), ("baseline_run_id", "runs"),
                            ("alternative_run_id", "runs")):
            if handoff.get(field):
                closure.need(kind, handoff[field], "Original Conservation paired experiment")


def _design(closure, path, value, plan):
    key = path.parent.name
    kind = "preparation" if path.name == "preparation.json" else "receiving"
    study = _record(closure, "conservation", plan["study_id"])
    expected = (digest(value.get("selection")) if kind == "preparation" else
                digest({"workspace_id": closure.workspace.project["id"],
                        "handover_sha256": value.get("input", {}).get("sha256")}))
    reference = value["selection"].get("source_reference") if kind == "preparation" else value.get("source_reference")
    if (value.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-design/v1" or value.get("kind") != kind
            or value.get("id") != key or key != expected or value.get("state") != "complete"
            or value.get("workspace_id") != closure.workspace.project["id"]
            or value.get("study_id") != study["id"] or reference != _reference(closure, plan, study)):
        raise ValueError("The Conservation editable design lost its original portfolio binding.")
    relative = path.parent.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix()
    closure.read(path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
    closure.tree(relative)
    _files(closure, value["files"], relative)
    if kind == "preparation":
        binding = _read_file(closure, value["files"]["binding"])
        if (binding.get("id") != value["binding_id"]
                or binding.get("source_reference") != reference
                or digest({name: item for name, item in binding.items() if name != "id"}) != binding["id"]):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation editable project binding changed.")
    else:
        for field, group in (("scenario_id", "scenarios"), ("run_id", "runs"),
                             ("source_collection_id", "sources")):
            if value.get(field):
                closure.need(group, value[field], "Original received Conservation design")
        closure._source_refs(value.get("input", {}), "Original Conservation design input edition")


def related(closure):
    """Include saved portfolios and their existing original editing continuations."""
    studies = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "conservation"}
    plans = {key for kind, key in closure.nodes if kind == "conservation-plans"}
    if not studies and not plans:
        return
    for kind in ("conservation-plans", "conservation-exports", "conservation-report-sources"):
        for path in sorted((closure.root / kind).glob("*/" + DOCUMENTS[kind])):
            if (kind, path.parent.name) in closure.nodes:
                continue
            try:
                value = read_json(path)
                if not isinstance(value, dict) or not (
                        value.get("study_id") in studies or value.get("plan_id") in plans):
                    continue
                _identity(kind, identifier(path.parent.name), value)
                closure.need(kind, path.parent.name, "Retained result of the selected Conservation study")
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
                issue = {"path": path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix(), "message": str(error)}
                if issue not in closure.related_issues:
                    closure.related_issues.append(issue)
    # Original bridge/design owners keep their own directory shape. Retain that
    # shape directly; do not invent generic record kinds or rewrite their IDs.
    patterns = ("conservation-scenarios/*/scenario.json",
                "conservation-design/preparations/*/preparation.json",
                "conservation-design/received/*/receiving.json")
    for pattern in patterns:
        for path in sorted(closure.root.glob(pattern)):
            value = read_json(path)
            plan_id = (value.get("selection") or {}).get("plan_id") if pattern.startswith("conservation-scenarios") else value.get("plan_id")
            if plan_id not in plans:
                continue
            plan = _record(closure, "conservation-plans", plan_id)
            (_scenario if pattern.startswith("conservation-scenarios") else _design)(closure, path, value, plan)
    for path in sorted(closure.root.glob("conservation-exports/catalog/*/export.json")):
        value = read_json(path)
        reference = value.get("reference") or {}
        if reference.get("study_id") not in studies:
            continue
        if (value.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-candidate-export/v1"
                or value.get("id") != path.parent.name or digest(reference) != path.parent.name):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation candidate export changed its original selection.")
        prefix = path.parent.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix()
        closure.read(path.relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
        closure.tree(prefix)
        _files(closure, value["files"], prefix)


def lock_paths(closure):
    paths = set()
    for kind, key in closure.nodes:
        if kind == "conservation":
            base = closure.root / kind / key
            for folder, filename in (("catalog", ".catalog.lock"), ("catalog-selections", ".selection.lock")):
                for path in base.glob(folder + "/*"):
                    if path.is_dir():
                        paths.add((path / filename).relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
        elif kind == "conservation-exports":
            paths.add(kind + "/" + key + "/.optimization-export.lock")
    for prefix in closure.trees:
        if prefix.startswith("conservation-scenarios/") and len(PurePosixPath(prefix).parts) == 2:
            paths.add(prefix + "/.create.lock")
            for path in (closure.root / prefix).glob("experiments/*"):
                paths.add((path / ".handoff.lock").relative_to(closure.root).as_posix())
        elif prefix.startswith("conservation-design/preparations/"):
            paths.add(prefix + "/.prepare.lock")
        elif prefix.startswith("conservation-design/received/"):
            paths.add(prefix + "/.receive.lock")
        elif prefix.startswith("conservation-exports/catalog/"):
            paths.add(prefix + "/.catalog-export.lock")
    return sorted(paths)


def include_source(closure, collection_id, entry):
    """Resolve only the original saved-Conservation scientific-report producer."""
    metadata = entry.get("metadata") or {}
    origin = metadata.get("origin") or {}
    if metadata.get("source_kind") != "saved_conservation_portfolio" and origin.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA:
        return False
    closure.add_file(entry["body"]["object"], entry["body"])
    recipe = closure.read(entry["body"]["object"])
    origin = recipe.get("origin") or {}
    key = identifier(origin.get("id"))
    if (entry.get("kind") != "document" or entry.get("role") != observed_context.ROLE
            or entry.get("id") != "conservation-portfolio-" + key
            or recipe.get("schema") != observed_context.SCHEMA or recipe.get("edition") not in REPORT_EDITIONS
            or origin.get("schema") != REPORT_SCHEMA or metadata.get("origin") != origin):
        raise ValueError("The saved Conservation report differs from its original source producer.")
    members = {}
    for item in entry.get("companions", []):
        name = _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
        if name in members:
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report repeats an original companion path.")
        closure.add_file(item["object"], item)
        members[name] = item
    inputs = {item["path"]: item for item in recipe.get("inputs", [])}
    if (len(inputs) != len(recipe.get("inputs", [])) or set(inputs) != set(members)
            or any(not _same(item, members[name]) for name, item in inputs.items())):
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report lost an original declared input.")
    def read(name):
        if name not in members:
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report needs its original companion " + name)
        return closure.read(members[name]["object"])
    study, plan = read("records/study.json"), read("records/plan.json")
    study_id, plan_id = identifier(origin["study_id"]), identifier(origin["plan_id"])
    _identity("conservation", study_id, study)
    _identity("conservation-plans", plan_id, plan)
    portfolio = read("records/portfolio.json")
    originals = read("records/source-bindings.json")
    if (plan.get("study_id") != study_id or plan["selection"].get("study_id") != study_id
            or portfolio.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-portfolio/v1"
            or portfolio.get("id") != plan_id or portfolio.get("study_id") != study_id
            or portfolio.get("selected_ids") != plan.get("selected_ids")
            or portfolio.get("summary") != plan.get("summary")
            or not _same(members["records/portfolio.json"], plan["files"]["portfolio"])
            or not _same(members["records/candidates.json"], study["files"]["candidates"])
            or plan["selection"].get("candidates_sha256") != study["files"]["candidates"]["sha256"]
            or plan["selection"].get("geometries_sha256") != study["files"]["geometries"]["sha256"]
            or originals.get("schema") != "upstate.conservation-report-originals/v1"
            or originals.get("study_id") != study_id):
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report lost its original study, portfolio or candidates.")
    optimization = None
    # Edition 1 predates separate optimization companions. Keep that immutable
    # source valid; its editable plan still retains the original analysis tree.
    if recipe["edition"] != "conservation-saved-plan-report/1":
        reference = plan["selection"].get("optimization")
        if reference is not None:
            analysis = read("optimization/analysis.json")
            optimization = _optimization_analysis(study, plan, analysis)
            roles = _optimization_roles(analysis)
            if "joint_comparison" in analysis and recipe["edition"] not in {
                    "conservation-saved-plan-report/5", "conservation-saved-plan-report/6"}:
                raise ValueError("Joint Conservation report companions require their original edition 5 or 6.")
            if {name for name in members if name.startswith("optimization/")} != {
                    "optimization/" + name for name in roles.values()}:
                raise ValueError("The Conservation report optimization member inventory changed.")
            if (not isinstance(reference, dict)
                    or not isinstance(reference.get("files"), dict)
                    or set(reference["files"]) != set(roles)):
                raise ValueError("The Conservation report needs its original optimization files.")
            for role, name in roles.items():
                if not _same(reference["files"][role], members.get("optimization/" + name)):
                    raise ValueError("The Conservation report lost an original optimization companion.")
        elif any(name.startswith("optimization/") for name in members):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report has optimization files without its saved decision.")
    local = origin.get("project_id") == closure.workspace.project["id"]
    if not isinstance(origin.get("project_id"), str) or not origin["project_id"]:
        raise ValueError("The Conservation report needs its original project identity.")
    for original in originals["sources"]:
        source_collection = identifier(original["source_collection_id"])
        original_entry = original["entry"]
        if original_entry.get("id") != original.get("source_id"):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report source inventory changed.")
        prefix = "originals/" + source_collection + "/" + digest(original["source_id"]) + "/"
        for item in [original_entry["body"], *original_entry.get("companions", [])]:
            name = prefix + _relative(item.get("view_path", item["filename"]))
            if name not in members or not _same(item, members[name]):
                raise ValueError("The Conservation report lost an original planning-source body.")
        if local:
            _source_entry(closure, original, original_entry)
    required = []
    if local:
        receipt = _record(closure, "conservation-report-sources", key)
        identity = receipt.get("selection") or {}
        _identity("conservation-report-sources", key, receipt)
        original_entry = _source_entry(closure, receipt["source"])
        if (receipt.get("edition") != recipe["edition"]
                or identity.get("edition") != recipe["edition"]
                or (recipe["edition"] != "conservation-saved-plan-report/1"
                    and identity.get("optimization") != optimization)
                or identity.get("project_id") != origin["project_id"]
                or identity.get("source_entries") != originals["sources"]
                or identity.get("plan_id") != plan_id or identity.get("study_id") != study_id
                or identity.get("packet", {}).get("id") != origin.get("packet_id")
                or _entry_identity(original_entry) != _entry_identity(entry)
                or not _same(identity.get("packet"), members["decision-packet.zip"])
                or not _same(receipt.get("files", {}).get("recipe"), entry["body"])
                or not _same(identity.get("plan"), members["records/plan.json"])
                or not _same(identity.get("study"), members["records/study.json"])):
            raise ValueError("The Conservation report differs from its original editable capture.")
        for kind, record_id, original in (("conservation", study_id, study),
                                         ("conservation-plans", plan_id, plan)):
            if _record(closure, kind, record_id) != original:
                raise ValueError("The Conservation report and original editable study differ.")
        for kind, record_id in (("conservation-report-sources", key), ("conservation", study_id),
                                ("conservation-plans", plan_id), ("conservation-exports", origin["packet_id"])):
            closure.need(kind, record_id, "Original editable saved Conservation report")
            required.append({"kind": kind, "id": record_id})
    binding = {"schema": "upstate.study-report-lineage/v1",
               "source_collection_id": collection_id, "source_id": entry["id"],
               "source_body_sha256": entry["body"]["sha256"], "source_project_id": origin["project_id"],
               "report_context_kind": "conservation_portfolio", "report_source_id": key,
               "study_id": study_id, "plan_id": plan_id, "packet_id": origin["packet_id"],
               "relationship": "same_project" if local else "external_project", "required_records": required}
    token = (collection_id, entry["id"])
    previous = closure.report_source_records.get(token)
    if previous is not None and previous != binding:
        raise ValueError("A Conservation report source changed during study selection.")
    closure.report_source_records[token] = binding
    return True


def catalogue(workspace, kind):
    if kind not in ROOT_KINDS:
        return []
    root = Path(workspace.root).resolve()
    rows = []
    for path in sorted((root / kind).glob("*/" + DOCUMENTS[kind])):
        key = path.parent.name
        try:
            identifier(key)
            if path.is_symlink() or path.parent.is_symlink() or not path.resolve().is_relative_to(root):
                raise ValueError("Keep the Conservation study in its original Workspace.")
            value = read_json(path)
            _identity(kind, key, value)
            rows.append({"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": value.get("title") or LABELS[kind] + " " + key[:12],
                         "state": value.get("state", "complete"),
                         "updated_at": value.get("completed_at") or value.get("created_at", ""),
                         "study_id": value.get("study_id"), "plan_id": value.get("plan_id")})
        except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
            rows.append({"kind": kind, "id": key, "title": key[:12], "state": "unreadable",
                         "updated_at": "", "error": {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}})
    return rows
